description: Asist parser corpus EXTENSION from product review 05b_critique_product.md. Same shape as parser_corpus.json. Every case is status=proposed: it documents a realistic work utterance the current 02 spec/corpus mishandles, with the result the user expects. Merge a case into parser_corpus.json only together with the rule change named in its proposedRule (and update the cases listed in conflictsWith). New expected keys: expected.leadMinutes (needs ParsedItem.leadTimesMinutes) and command.targetDate (needs ParsedCommand.targetDate).

fieldNotes.due: Local time in timeZone, 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm'. For snooze commands it is the new due (command.date). null = must be nil.
fieldNotes.title: Exact expected string; null = not checked (always null for commands).
fieldNotes.recurrence: freq daily|weekly|monthly|yearly; weekdays ISO 1=Pazartesi..7=Pazar; monthDay -1 = last day of month.
fieldNotes.command: Only keys present are compared. query is compared after Turkish lowercasing + whitespace collapse. date is 'YYYY-MM-DD'.
fieldNotes.person/project: Read from item, or from command for commands.
fieldNotes.minConfidence/maxConfidence: confidence >= minConfidence; when maxConfidence is present, confidence <= maxConfidence (low-confidence cases).
fieldNotes.status: proposed = expected behaviour after the rule in proposedRule is adopted; the current spec fails these cases.
fieldNotes.gap: What the current 02 rules produce / why the case fails today.
fieldNotes.proposedRule: Rule id from 05b §6 (G1…G12) and the concrete lexicon/grammar change.
fieldNotes.conflictsWith: Existing parser_corpus.json case ids whose expectation must change if the rule is adopted.
fieldNotes.leadMinutes: Proposed ParsedItem.leadTimesMinutes (minutes before due). Absent = not checked.
fieldNotes.targetDate: Proposed ParsedCommand.targetDate for snooze: day filter of the item to move ('YYYY-MM-DD'); command.date/due stays the NEW date.

cases.gap: Unknown line 'Hat 2' (only 'Hat 3' is a known project): '2'de' is read as clock 2 -> PM rule -> 14:00.
cases.proposedRule: G1: N+LOC/DAT directly after an equipment noun (hat, hattı, istasyon, robot, hücre, pano, kat, bant, konveyör, eksen, makine, kabin, no, numara) is part of the noun phrase, never a clock.

cases.input: İstasyon 5'te hava kaçağı var, cuma bakılsın
cases.gap: '5'te' -> 17:00 on Friday instead of the default day time.
cases.proposedRule: G1

cases.input: Pano 2'de klemens gevşek, yarın sabah baktır
cases.gap: '2'de' competes with 'yarın sabah' (non-adjacent AM qualifier): current rules give 14:00 or 02:00, never 09:00.
cases.proposedRule: G1

cases.gap: '3' raises unusedNumber (-0.10) although 'nolu/numaralı' makes it part of a name -> needless confirm card.
cases.proposedRule: G1: number followed by nolu/numaralı/no'lu/numara is consumed as part of the noun; no unusedNumber flag.

cases.gap: 'gelecek' is excluded as a waiting verb (homonym of 'next'); utterance becomes a reminder titled 'Sürücüler gelecek'. P7 would also turn the dictation-capitalised 'Sürücüler' into a person.
cases.proposedRule: G2: 'gelecek' as the LAST token (not followed by hafta/ay/yıl/sene/weekday) is a waiting verb. P7 at index 0 rejects plural (-ler/-lar) and common nouns (tedarikçi, müşteri, firma, servis, ekip, malzeme, sürücü...).

cases.gap: 'haber verecek' is not in the waiting-verb list (only cevap/yanıt verecek).
cases.proposedRule: G2: add haber verecek, bilgi verecek, dönüş sağlayacak.

cases.gap: 1st person plural 'bekliyoruz' (team voice, very common for a manager) is not a waiting cue.
cases.proposedRule: G2: add bekliyoruz, bekleniyor, bekleyeceğiz, beklemedeyiz.

cases.input: Mehmet test raporunu akşama kadar atacak
cases.gap: 'atacak' (mail/rapor atacak) missing from the waiting-verb list.
cases.proposedRule: G2: add atacak, paylaşacak, yükleyecek, çıkaracak, kesecek (fatura), ayarlayacak, bitirecek, düzeltecek, onaylayacak(already).

cases.gap: 'paylaşacak' missing; also 'Elektrik projesi' is a DOCUMENT (electrical drawings) - the app must not propose 'Yeni proje: Elektrik'.
cases.proposedRule: G2 + app rule: 'Yeni proje' chip unselected by default and suppressed for elektrik/pnömatik/hidrolik/mekanik/yazılım/PLC/TIA/otomasyon/montaj projesi.

cases.gap: 'kaydır' is listed in 03 §5.6 but not in 02 §10.5 snooze cues.
cases.proposedRule: G3: snooze cues += kaydır, taşı, ötele(exists), sonraya at, sonraya bırak, DATE+DAT bırak, DATE+DAT al (only when the object is a pronoun or ends with işini/hatırlatmasını/görevini/toplantısını, or no object).

cases.gap: 'al' is a content verb (buy/take) -> task 'Bunu al' tomorrow.
cases.proposedRule: G3 (pronoun object + DAT date + al => snooze)

cases.gap: 'taşı' not a snooze cue -> task 'Raporu taşı' Monday.
cases.proposedRule: G3

cases.gap: 'bırak' not a snooze cue; and 'haftaya' alone = +7 days (Fri 9 Oct) in 02, but 03 §5.7 says next week's Monday.
cases.proposedRule: G3 + decision D-HAFTAYA: 'haftaya'/'gelecek hafta' WITHOUT weekday = next week's first workday at default time.

cases.gap: ParsedCommand has one `date`; for snooze it is the NEW date, so the target-day filter ('cuma günkü') is lost and the matcher may pick another meeting. 'günkü' is also not a recognised weekday glue word.
cases.proposedRule: API: add ParsedCommand.targetDate (day filter for snooze); lexicon: weekday + günkü/günki.

cases.gap: 'iptal oldu / iptal edildi' (reported cancellation) is not recognised because 'oldu' follows the cue.
cases.proposedRule: G4: cancel cues += iptal oldu, iptal edildi, yapılmayacak, gerek kalmadı(exists).

cases.gap: Lexicon has 'boşver' (one word); dictation writes 'boş ver'.
cases.proposedRule: G4: add two-token 'boş ver'.

cases.gap: Only 1sg past (-DIm) counts; 1pl (-DIk: hallettik, gönderdik, yaptık) is very common for a team lead.
cases.proposedRule: G5: accept -DIk / -DIk twin forms wherever -DIm is accepted.

cases.gap: Content-verb completion list is 1sg only (aldım).
cases.proposedRule: G5

cases.gap: 03 §5.6 lists 'geldi (takip)' as completion; 02 has no such cue -> reminder/note titled 'Mehmet'ten çizimler geldi'.
cases.proposedRule: G5: 'geldi / ulaştı / elime geçti / teslim alındı' at the end = complete (preferably of waiting items).

cases.gap: 'gitti / gönderildi / iletildi' (passive/3sg completion) not recognised.
cases.proposedRule: G5

cases.gap: DANGEROUS: 'unuttum' matches the generic 1sg past rule -> complete command with target 'neyi'. 03 §5.6 lists it as a query.
cases.proposedRule: G6: 'ne(yi|leri) unuttum / kaçırdım / atladım' = query overdue; checked BEFORE the generic -DIm completion rule.

cases.gap: Same as xqry-001 ('kaçırdım' = generic past -> complete).
cases.proposedRule: G6

cases.gap: Question form 'var mı' is not a query phrase; 'toplantım' counts as content -> reminder 'Toplantım var mı' tomorrow 09:00.
cases.proposedRule: G6: '(… ) var mı' = query; content noun becomes a text filter (new ParsedCommand.queryText use for queries).

cases.gap: A bare hour without saat/suffix is not a clock, so '4 gibi' is ignored (09:00 + unusedNumber).
cases.proposedRule: G7: N (1…24) followed by gibi/civarı/civarında/sularında/raddelerinde is a clock phrase.

cases.gap: Possessive dayparts 'sabahı / öğleni / akşamı / gecesi' (salı sabahı, cuma akşamı) are missing from §5.5; 'sabahı' leaks into the title.
cases.proposedRule: G7: daypart keys += sabahi, sabahi(nda), oglesi, aksami, aksamustu(nu), gecesi (+LOC).

cases.gap: 'öğleden önce' has no daypart; 'öğle' may be matched (12:00) and 'önce' pollutes the title.
cases.proposedRule: G7: new setting ogledenOnce = 11:00; keys ogleden once, ogleye kadar, ogleden evvel.

cases.gap: 'içinde' after a day word is not glue -> title pollution ('İçinde teklif…') or a broken duration parse.
cases.proposedRule: G7: 'bugün içinde / gün içinde / bugün bir ara' = today policy (8.2a) with hasTime=false.

cases.gap: Clock grammar accepts only LOC/DAT suffixes; 'N'dan sonra' (after 10) is ignored or misread as a duration.
cases.proposedRule: G7: N+ABL sonra (and N+DAT doğru) = clock N.

cases.gap: 'öğle yemeğinde' exists but 'öğle yemeğinden sonra' does not: result is 12:00 (before lunch ends) with 'yemeğinden sonra' in the title.
cases.proposedRule: G7: 'öğle yemeğinden sonra / öğle arasından sonra / öğleden sonra ilk iş' = ogle + 60 min.

cases.input: bu gece vardiyada saat 3'te fırın sıcaklığını kontrol et
cases.gap: The NIGHT qualifier only applies when adjacent to the clock; 'bu gece … saat 3'te' becomes today 15:00 (PM rule) + conflicting daypart.
cases.proposedRule: G7: an explicit 'bu gece / gece vardiyasında' anywhere in the utterance qualifies a 1–6 clock as NIGHT.

cases.gap: Two clocks: the spec defines merging only for multiple DAY expressions (first wins); a spoken correction keeps the wrong (first) value.
cases.proposedRule: G8: 'hayır / yok / pardon / yani / değil de / yok yok' between two values of the same type => the LAST value wins; the marker is consumed.

cases.input: yarın değil öbür gün Hat 3 raporunu gönder
cases.gap: 'yarın değil öbür gün' -> conflictingDates, FIRST date (yarın) kept = exactly the date the user rejected.
cases.proposedRule: G8

cases.input: çok acil Ahmet Bey'i hemen ara
cases.gap: Corpus pri-009 expects an UNDATED critical task: the most urgent thing he says never produces a notification.
cases.proposedRule: G9: 'hemen / şimdi / derhal / acilen' with no other time => due = now + hemenMinutes (5).

cases.input: acil değil ama bu hafta Profinet adreslerini kontrol et
cases.gap: 'bu hafta' is only a query scope; as an item deadline it is ignored -> undated low task that never resurfaces.
cases.proposedRule: G9: 'bu hafta (içinde) / hafta bitmeden' = last workday of the current week at default time, flag vagueDate.

cases.input: Perşembe 14'te ABB ile toplantı var, yarım saat önce hatırlat
cases.gap: 03 §5.8 #9 exactly: 'yarım saat önce' is not extracted (04 says pre-alerts only via detail screen) and stays in the title; the user believes he will be warned at 13:30 and is not.
cases.proposedRule: G10: 'DURATION önce (hatırlat|haber ver|uyar)' / 'DURATION kala' => ParsedItem.leadTimesMinutes (new field); planner already supports leadTimesMinutes.

cases.input: 15 Ekim'de TIA Portal lisansı bitiyor, bir hafta önce hatırlat
cases.gap: License/certificate expiries are a core use case (03 §6.1 #25) but lead times are not parsed.
Dotted a.b with a DAT suffix is always a TIME (§8.6 rule 1) -> reminder today 16:20.
cases.proposedRule: G11: dotted number preceded (≤2 tokens) by firmware/sürüm/versiyon/v/revizyon/rev/güncelleme or followed by güncelle/yükselt is a version, not a time.

cases.gap: 'son günü' is an ordinal day-of-month (-1): resolves to 30 Sep and then conflicts with 'cuma' (first date wins = wrong).
cases.proposedRule: G11: 'son gün(ü) / son tarih / deadline' are day-of-month only after 'ayın' / a month name; otherwise they are title words and the explicit day wins.

cases.input: her 6 ayda bir kompresör filtrelerini değiştir
cases.gap: 'N ayda bir' (periodic maintenance: 3/6 months) is missing from §9.1; 'N günde bir' and 'ayda bir' exist.
cases.proposedRule: G12: 'her N ayda bir / N ayda bir' => monthly interval N, monthDay = today; first occurrence = today + N months (a maintenance interval starts after the job just done). Weekend landing shows the 'Pazartesiye al' chip.

cases.input: her ayın ilk pazartesi yönetim toplantısı
cases.gap: Nth-weekday-of-month cannot be represented by Recurrence; current rules may yield 'monthly day 1' (wrong: fires on the 1st) silently.
cases.proposedRule: G12 (v1): detect 'ayın (ilk|ikinci|üçüncü|son) WEEKDAY' => recurrence nil, due = next such day, flag unsupportedRecurrence (review). v1.1: Recurrence.weekOrdinal.
